svg.text: 2-mass model of the stacker crane mast (first bending mode) and the effect of the motion profile
q_res = a/ω² · |sin(π f t_r) / (π f t_r)|
mast top deflection q (mm), 26 m move
trapezoid, ζ = 0.02 – sway stays after the stop
S-curve, ramp time = 1 mast period – almost no residual sway
trapezoid + active sway damping in the drive (ζ = 0.2)
1 jerk limit / input shaping matched to f_mast (no extra sensor)
2 active damping: accelerometer at the mast top (or observer)
feeds back q' to the travel speed set point
3 two travel drives (bottom + top) on tall masts move the top
with the base (master / slave, torque sharing)
4 fine positioning waits until |q| < 2 mm (settling time)
EXAMPLE – check the AS/RS supplier's documentation
